name: destroy
declaration: unsafe extern "C" fn destroy < T > (ptr : * mut u8)
documentation:
Transition an `Alive` TLS variable into the `Destroyed` state, dropping its
 value.

 # Safety
 * Must only be called at thread destruction.
 * `ptr` must point to an instance of `Storage<T, ()>` and be valid for
   accessing that instance.
rules: destroy<T> must only be called at thread destruction.
For destroy<T>, ptr must point to an instance of Storage<T, ()> and be valid for accessing that instance.
